name: Beast of Nurgle

bonuses.name: Deadly Slime Trail
bonuses.text: Anyone engaged with this threat becomes Restrained until they disengage or the threat is eliminated.

abilities.name: Frightful Form
abilities.text: Anyone that can see this threat must make a DN 3 Fear Test.

determination: Daemonic Determination: Spend 1 Ruin to roll 5d6. Daemons can roll Determination against Mortal Wounds. Any Wounds negated by Determination are ignored instead of being converted to Shock.
note: Putrid Appendage prints no range, so it is stored with range [1]. Block header reads 'Beasts of Nurgle'.
